title: docs(pm-dispatch): past 150k context at a wave stop, a seat flushes its post and continues in a fresh session of the same seat
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DHM1nDdFJ61TqcMuSeAFEei)_

domain:skills#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxMAW9mw1tRNsCsCc2

Fixes #32857

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`seat-lifecycle.md` 的波次收工点末行改为「存档后上下文超过 150k 就请协调者开新会话同席续班,不等自动压缩」;`seat-post-protocol.md` 在交接清单前加四行「同席续班」形式:账号、座位贴、信箱不变,新会话重订信箱与在飞 PR、把巡查改绑到自己、在贴上记 `Successor-of:`,旧会话结束,不发上下线通知。
- **为什么改**:维护者 2026-11-12 22:06Z「车队省 token 执行要求」第 7 条。座位会话的开销约等于上下文大小乘调用次数,以前座位只能一路跑到自动压缩(实测峰值 347k、25 小时 272 美元);换一次会话约付 70k 缓存写入,十次调用左右回本。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 `.claude/**` 两份规则文本,行数不变(98 和 88),上限行不动;回滚即 revert。四行新增靠同文件删四行付账,其中两处是删重复子句后并行,请复审确认算删内容而不是折行。
- **先看**:① `seat-post-protocol.md` 新增四行(续班形式本身,含一条卡上没有的「前任笔迹归继任、不自退」);② 同文件被删的 `:59`、`:61` 两行平台事实;③ `seat-lifecycle.md:82`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,预期两份文件各报 `98 lines (ceiling 98; headroom 0)` 与 `88 lines (ceiling 88; headroom 0)`,无超 120 字节行。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位复审后落地(Tier S)。

## What changes

Both files stay at their ceilings (seat-lifecycle 98, seat-post-protocol 88); no ceiling row moves. Line numbers are on `origin/main` a7c97297.

| Part | Where | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 1 context check at the wave stop | `seat-lifecycle.md:82`, in place | 「`/compact` 由维护者在终端会话择机执行,永远不是派发前提。」 becomes 「存档后上下文 >150k ⇒ 请协调者开新会话同席续班,⛔ 不等自动压缩;永远不是派发前提。」 It is the third sentence of the wave-stop item, so it applies only where in-flight is zero; `:80` (⛔ not mid-review) and `:81` (the flush) are untouched. |
| 2 same-seat continuation | `seat-post-protocol.md`, four lines at the end of 〈活性、写侧刷新与收班〉, directly above 〈交接收尾清单〉 | A continuation is not a handover: account, seat post and mailbox PR stay; ⛔ it does not walk the handover checklist and sends no `seat-offline`/`seat-online`. The old session writes its judgment into the post; the successor re-subscribes the mailbox PR and the in-flight PRs, puts its session id on the stub and records `Successor-of:` the old session. The patrol is re-bound by the successor creating its own self-bound routine and deleting the old one, with the `Patrol:` line updated; every trace the predecessor left on the seat (its `Claim:` comments, round-open marks, branch pushes) counts as the successor's, so the successor does not stand down; then the old session ends. The context reading is `get_session` with no argument, `external_metadata.context_usage.used_tokens`; when that is unreadable or `0`, the coordinator reads the seat's session by id. |

**Line payment in `seat-post-protocol.md` (four lines added, four paid in the same file):**

1. `:19` + `:20` → one line. Dropped 「编辑历史即存档」 (the next line's 「旧账留在上一版 body revision」 is the same fact), 「把交接的有效内容」 and the parenthetical 「(哪一版、何时)」.
2. `:40` + `:42` → one line. Dropped 「标题词表不扩」 (`:10` is already the closed 状态词表) and 「收班座位恒 `⏳ vacant`」 (checklist step 6 says it). The 留守登记 clause that `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs:309` cites is kept word for word; 「不是阻塞」 reads 「非阻塞」.
3. `:59` deleted: 「Routines UI 并无 GitHub 连接器入口。」 It is the reason behind `:58`'s 「凭据随所挂 repo sources 走」, which stays.
4. `:61` deleted: 「模型不能经 API 钉住,同样在 UI 钉;Routine 继承环境默认模型,环境默认变了它跟着变。」 `platform-readings.md` 〈断粮检测与跨墙恢复〉 holds the current facts (the create side has no `model`; the update side has one that only fresh-session routines pick up), and `:64` keeps 「档位与 cron 是维护者在 UI 上的可调项」.

Readings, whole file, `origin/main` a7c97297 → this head: `seat-post-protocol.md` 88 lines / 7,438 bytes → 88 lines / 7,622 bytes; `seat-lifecycle.md` 98 lines / 8,835 bytes → 98 lines / 8,873 bytes. The line count is flat and the bytes grow by 222 in total. Payments 1 and 2 each delete restated clauses and then join what is left; payments 3 and 4 are whole-line deletions.

## Why

The maintainer's words, 2026-11-12 (UTC), verbatim: 21:46:10Z 「任务很多，评估如何节约 token」; 21:50:27Z 「以上建议用 fable评审，然后立skills 卡优化」; 21:54:51Z 「…按照你的意见补充立卡并全部交给 skills 车道 派发。都是 p1」; and rule 7 of the consolidated 22:06Z 「车队省 token 执行要求」:

「7. 上下文：到收工点（在飞归零）时，上下文超过 150k 就把判断写进座位贴，请协调者开新会话同席续班。续班沿用原信箱，把巡查 routine 改绑到新会话，旧会话结束。复核进行到一半时不换。」

The card carries the measured spend: cache reads are 65–78% of a session's cost, seats reach 225–262k context within 15–40 minutes of seating, and a seat cannot compact itself, so it ran to autocompact.

## Deviations

- **Rule 7 over the card, as the order says.** The threshold reads 「>150k」 (「超过」), not the card's 「≥150k」; the coordinator opens the successor; the old session ends last, after the re-bind.
- **The card's 「(`check-handover.mjs` 退出 0)」 is not written.** Rule 7 does not carry it, and by the script's own header its refusal (a) is a card the departing session still holds at `pm:dispatched` with no `Release:`. A continuation keeps its claims (a cloud card may be in flight at a wave stop: 「云卡不挡」), so requiring exit 0 would force the hand-back that Part 2 says a continuation must not do. Read from the header, not run.
- **`update_trigger` cannot move a trigger to another session** (the card's Part 2 mechanism). Its parameter list, read in this session on 2026-11-13: `trigger_id`, `name`, `cron_expression`, `enabled`, `model`, `prompt`, `run_once_at`, `ask_owner`. No session field. A trigger's target is fixed by `create_trigger` (this session by default, or `persistent_session_id`). So the line says the successor creates its own self-bound routine and deletes the old one, which is also what `platform-readings.md` already rules for a dead bound session (「先删旧 Routine、再从新会话重建」). This is a schema reading: no trigger was created, updated or deleted to test it.
- **`0` is treated as unreadable.** `get_session` with no argument, called during this session's first turn, answered `external_metadata.context_usage` = `max_tokens: 500000, used_tokens: 0` while the context was plainly not empty. NOT MEASURED: whether a later turn boundary reads a true value.
- **One clause is not on the card: 「前任笔迹归继任不自退」.** 〈开轮互斥〉 retires a session that finds another session's same-seat traces (its `Claim:`, its round-open mark, a branch push) with no sign-off brief after them; a continuation writes no sign-off brief, so without this clause the successor's first act would be to stand down. The first draft named only `Claim:`; the seat's review (should-fix) widened it to every trace, in the file's own word 「笔迹」.
- **Citations live here, not in the skill lines**, as in the sibling PRs: these files carry rules only, and no line has room at 120 bytes with zero headroom.
- **The old `/compact` sentence is gone**, as in the card's wanted text.

## Resolved at review

- 「固定波数」 had no number. The seat's review (should-fix) replaced it with 「读不到或 0 归协调者读」: a `0` reading is a young session that needs no swap, and an unreadable one is a host whose `get_session` cannot see the calling session, where the coordinator, who opens the successor anyway, reads the seat's session by id. No wave count is needed.

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` keys refusal (a) on `--session`. After a continuation, a card whose newest `Claim:` still carries the predecessor's session is listed, not refused, when the successor later signs off under its own id (header, 「LISTED, not refused」). Read-only inference, not reproduced; noted, not filed. carrier: none.
- The `update_trigger` parameter fact above is not in `platform-readings.md`; that file is outside this card's surface. carrier: none.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 0 on 7a8bec5b: 「seat-lifecycle.md is 98 lines (ceiling 98; headroom 0)」, 「seat-post-protocol.md is 88 lines (ceiling 88; headroom 0)」; no line over 120 bytes (widest new lines 119 and 118).
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` exit 0: 「113 file(s) clean」.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 17 commands) all exit 0 on 7a8bec5b; `--ran`: 「17 derived, 17 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN」. First pass on 5664f227: 16 exit 0 and `check:doc-formula-expressions` exit 3 (unbuilt `@objectstack/lint`); after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build` under the verify lock it exits 0.
- `origin/main` merged once before opening (a7c97297, which brought PR 32918's edits to `seat-lifecycle.md:77` and `seat-post-protocol.md:78–88`): no conflict, the same 17 commands derived, all rerun on the merge head.
- `git grep` of `scripts/`, `.github/`, `.claude/` and `docs/` for every sentence deleted or reworded: the only hit is the 留守登记 clause, kept verbatim.
- skip-changeset: `.claude/**` is not published.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (one stub key, `Successor-of:`, in the form of `Resume-from:`)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran. (`.claude/**` markdown only; `pnpm lint` not run locally, CI reads it)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: skip-changeset)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block follows the seat convention)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
